messages:
Lina (Partnerships): Heads up  launching a small pilot for GigaChip marketplace leads; need to finalize SI co-sell handoff + joint-announce coordination.
Marco (SI): ok what's different vs current flow?
Lina (Partnerships): marketplace leads for GigaChip SKUs will enter a 48h alignment window for Sales + SI to map accounts. after window, if SI confirmed -> lock. we also need an announce coordination step for joint launches (embargo / press readiness).
Asha (Sales): 48h fine. for announce leads we need an expedite path if customer requests partner intro or mentions "joint launch" in intake.
Ben (Sales Ops): SFDC fields required: lead_claim_state, claim_ts, si_rel_flag, expedite_flag, staging_deadline, announce_tag. opsbot pseudocode:
```
if si_rel_flag or expedite_flag:
  owner = si_owner
else:
  owner = gigachip_alignment_queue
  staging_deadline = now + 48h
```
Marco (SI): important: if SI has existing contractual relationship (crm_partner_acv > 0) set si_rel_flag=true -> immediate claim. also propose a 24h no-outreach buffer after claim to prevent double emails.
Lina (Partnerships): for joint announcements, add announce_tag; if set, trigger partnerships->marcom notify workflow and add an embargo_date field. need a one-pager for partners explaining announcement cadence.
Asha (Sales): domain dedupe rules: canonicalize account_domain, then check parent_company. Subsidiaries (e.g., giga-eu vs giga-global) need manual stitch override. include auto 15m sync invite between rep + SI if ambiguous.
Marco (SI): request: single-click confirm email to SI to accept ownership and confirm readiness for partner intro. reduces SFDC friction.
handshakebot: lead GC-4200 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). metadata: account=GigaRetail, region=NA, tags=[marketplace, hw-partner, announce_candidate], si_rel_flag=false
Ben (Sales Ops): next steps: 1) I'll add SFDC fields in sandbox + opsbot rule (by Thu). 2) Partnerships to draft announce one-pager + ROE (Mon). 3) Sales + SI run two test leads (normal + announce) and report. 4) add dashboard widgets: avg time-to-claim, % announce escalations, and post-handoff conflicts.
Lina (Partnerships): timeline: run pilot 14 days, evaluate, then roll to marketplace intake if clean. I'll post the ROE + partner note here for quick review.
Asha (Sales): can we log examples of subsidiary edge cases in the doc? I'll add two by EOD.
Marco (SI): will run tests and validate no-contact buffer works. thanks all. :thumbsup:
